name: Taga Mahiro
source:
Ui's close friend and classmate. She is an athletic girl with a tanned skin and a track-and-field background. 

She has a friendly and cheerful personality and has as many friends as Ui. She is also a manly and easy-going person, so she has more male friends than Ui. She is talked to openly by the male members of the club.

She takes good care of her friends, and is greatly admired by the younger members of the club. She is a kind and very reliable senior.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/104renai/#character]official site[/url]]
